---
title: Chapter numbering
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
number-sections: true
crossref:
  chapters: true
filters:
  - typst-extras
_quarto:
  tests:
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'Figure 1.1: First' 'Figure 2.1: Target' 'See Figure 2.1' '(2.1)' 'Equation (2.1)' 'Theorem 2.1' 'Note 2.1' 'Figure 2.2: A panel' '(a) Left'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        - - '#let typst-extras-config = \(chapters: true'
          - '#let equation-numbering = typst-extras-wrap\(equation-numbering, "\(1\)"\)'
          - 'set figure\(numbering: typst-extras-wrap\(figure\.numbering, "1"\)\)'
          - 'typst-extras-reset-chapter\(\("quarto-float-fig", "quarto-float-tbl", "quarto-float-lst", "quarto-callout-Note"'
---

# One

![First square.](figure.svg){#fig-one fig-alt="A blue square."}

$$ {#eq-one}

:::

::: {#nte-x .callout-note}

:::

See @fig-panel, @fig-left and @fig-right.
